text: Could you make me a set of slides that look like they belong together for a cosy café? I’ve been thinking about how nice it feels to settle into a café on a quiet morning, and that’s why this idea appeals to me. What I need is 3 square Instagram carousel slides, with the text in this order: 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', 'Stay a little longer'. Please use warm cream and coffee-brown colours and simple illustrations. I’m a little worried about whether the overall feeling will come across, since it’s easier to picture in my head than explain. Please give me the three separate slides, ready to post.
